retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist pastoral scene featuring domestic or industrial objects like airplane seats placed in a vast, rolling green field under a hazy sky.
triggerTerms: rolling green hills with blue mountains background

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle landscape photograph of two men sitting in blue airplane seats positioned in the middle of a lush, tall green grass field. One man reads a book while the other plays an acoustic guitar. The background features rolling green hills leading to distant blue-toned mountains under a pale, overcast sky. A complex typographic logo is anchored in the top-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of industrial seating within a natural landscape
Horizontal layering of grass, hills, mountains, and sky
Triangular composition formed by the two figures in the lower center
Top-left typographic weight balancing the central subjects
coreInvariants: Tall green grass obscuring the base of the seats
Muted, naturalistic color palette with cool blue mountain tones
Soft, diffused daylight without harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures seated in the lower-middle third, scaled to appear integrated into the landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pair of airplane seats and the musicians sitting in them.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the typographic logo in the top-left, moves down to the central figures, and then sweeps across the horizon line of the hills.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of pale sky in the upper half and dense grass in the foreground.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a high-key, airy value range in the sky.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, condensed sans-serif with vertical striping or inline detail
Secondary text uses a clean, spaced-out geometric sans-serif
Logo element features a circular frame with decorative flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical line hatching inside the main title glyphs to create texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Decorative script-like serif paired with heavy industrial sans-serif and light geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Vertical hatching in the main title
Circular framing of the top word
Wide tracking of the bottom subtitle
avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy condensed vertical title
For the flared serif logo text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of two men in 1980s casual attire sitting in blue airplane seats in a tall green wheat field, one playing a guitar, one reading, with rolling hills and blue mountains in the background under a hazy sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a three-tiered typographic logo in the top-left corner: a circular framed serif word at the top, a large vertically-striped condensed sans-serif word in the middle, and a wide-tracked light sans-serif subtitle at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Check that the grass covers the bottom of the airplane seats
Ensure the mountains have a distinct blue atmospheric haze
Verify the typography is positioned in the top-left quadrant
Check for the vertical line texture inside the largest text

adjustableVariables: Atmospheric haze level on the mountains
Specific instruments held by the figures
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Is the horizon line straight and balanced?
Does the typography feel like a cohesive unit?
Are the colors of the figures' clothing harmonious with the landscape?
Is the scale of the seats realistic relative to the grass?
recipe.reuseFormula: Place [Industrial Object] in [Vast Natural Landscape] + [Two Figures in Casual Activity] + [Multi-tiered 80s Graphic Logo in Corner]
